body: Current released versions (2026-10-13): gqlkit v0.14.0, gqlkit-sdl v0.12.0, gqlkit-ts 0.3.0 (npm latest). Next releases are v0.14.1, v0.12.1 and 0.3.1 unless the owner asks for more. All three were released from the commit tagged gqlkit@v0.14.0 (look it up with git rev-parse 'gqlkit@v0.14.0^{commit}'; commit IDs changed when history was rewritten on 2026-10-13, so never record raw SHAs here).
